name: vyavastha
description: Checks your requests against what your team has said and decided before Codex changes code, sums each session up for teammates under categories you control, answers your questions about the team, and lets you ask teammates’ agents.

interface.shortDescription: Your team’s record, in Codex: checks, summaries and answers.
interface.longDescription: Once you turn it on in a project, Vyavastha checks each request against what your team has said and decided before Codex changes code, sums each session up for teammates under categories you control, answers your questions about the team, and lets you ask teammates’ agents. Send “vyavastha help” to see how to start.
